provenance.members: GQSEAF Defense System composition, checked against BTLusual formation records.
provenance.attachment_slots: PA markers are indexed by name. Formation-order child queue writes are checked against the original instructions. Core model PA00/01/02/03 resolve to bones 6/3/11/9.
provenance.deployment: Deploy at HP <= 66 percent using clip 32, blend 4 and timer 120; rate is extracted from REL section 4 offset 0x4984.
provenance.placement: REL section 4 offsets 0x4960/0x496c supply core/repair X, 0x4964 supplies Y/Z, and 0x4968 supplies heading.
provenance.repair: Self-revival delay starts at 1500 ticks and increases by 120 per revival; orbit delays are 900 ticks. Recovery restores 100/75 percent health. Core defense is divided by 4 and multiplied by 3 while repair is unavailable. Positional sound 104 uses priority 2. Revival uses the native recovery lifecycle without a separate particle effect.
provenance.messages: Messages display for 90 ticks; strings are extracted from REL section 4 offsets 0x4970, 0x497c and 0x498c.
provenance.camera: Maintained Resonance camera constraint that keeps the door behind the combatants.
